## Description

Please provide a summary of the change, including the problem being solved or the feature added.

Fixes # (issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 📚 Documentation update
- [ ] ⚡ Performance / Refactoring improvement

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the **Agent Interaction Contract** (CSS for hover, JS Spring for press).
- [ ] I have executed `npm test` locally and all tests pass (0 errors).
- [ ] I have added/updated unit tests or documentation if applicable.
- [ ] My changes adhere to Shadow DOM v1 and zero-dependency guidelines.
